title: Endowed with Power from on High
author: Jonathan A. Stapley

Joseph Smith, “Discourse, 28 April 1842,” 37, josephsmithpapers.org. Three days later, Joseph Smith preached a sermon describing the temple, where the elders were to receive the “keys of the kingdom” and be “endued with power” (“Discourse, 1 May 1842, as Reported by Willard Richards,” 94, josephsmithpapers.org).
